tradeoff: None beyond D-20261127-token-hashing-upgrade. Device revocation leaves JS-184's criterion 7 because none exists before JS-042, whose criterion 2 holds it.
serves: PRODUCT.md, "Joining and signing in are easy and safe"; Goal 3, "Octave's features have the server they need".
entry: JS-184 takes the refined criteria, kept at least as strong as before (same time, no name revealed, every refusal with its action). JS-227 is added after JS-226 to hash tokens from before JS-184. Only devices signed in through the new API appear in Jellyfin's lists under the server's device id. JS-216's design §C3 follows the contract's envelope, {reason, action} plus retryAfterSeconds, detail and scope where they apply. A disabled account's 401 on Jellyfin's routes stands until the cutover; jellyscale's API answers account-off after the right password (D-20261127-signin-reasons).
